summary_en: 241,400 shares (5.50% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) purchased via ToSTNeT-3 at ¥2,149/share (26 June 2026 closing price), total outlay ¥518.8M. For stock option exercises and restricted stock awards, capital efficiency, and operational flexibility. Controlling shareholder Osamu Nagata indicated intention to tender shares.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares and purchase of treasury shares via ToSTNeT-3 off-market trading
translation_en_brief: Choei Inc. announced on 25 June 2026 the acquisition of its own shares via off-market trading (ToSTNeT-3) on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, effective 26 June 2026. The company will purchase up to 241,400 shares at the closing price of ¥2,149 per share (including final special quotations), for a total outlay not exceeding ¥518.8 million. The share count represents 5.50% of outstanding shares (computed as 241,400 ÷ 4,386,968 ex-treasury denominator). The purchase is stated to support stock option exercises and restricted stock award distributions, while providing operational flexibility to adapt capital policy to business environment changes and improve capital efficiency. The controlling shareholder, Osamu Nagata, has indicated his intention to sell shares in the transaction. To mitigate conflicts of interest, the board resolution excluded the interested representative director; two independent outside directors (Shin Tanaka and Shigeto Ishihata) confirmed in writing on 19 June 2026 that the transaction meets fairness and minority-protection safeguards. The order is valid only during the ToSTNeT-3 trading window on 26 June, with results to be disclosed immediately after the 08:45 closing.
